mechanism: Rifampin is a potent inducer of CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, dramatically increasing tacrolimus metabolism and clearance, resulting in subtherapeutic tacrolimus levels and loss of immunosuppressive efficacy.
action: Avoid concomitant use if possible; if concurrent therapy is necessary, monitor tacrolimus levels closely (target 8-20 ng/mL) and expect need for significant dose increases (often 2-4 fold); consider alternative antibiotics with less enzyme induction.
